items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And Jimmy Bell was our leader at one time.

ctx.x: Sort of an intermission like. They'd put the lights on and they'd do the show. And the band would play too.
And Jimmy Bell was our leader at one time. And Carroll Dickerson was a leader there also.
That was, that was, wasn't that the job where you replaced Jimmy Bertrand at?
